rules: Each org_id MUST have exactly one active system account per system_account_type per (ledger_id,currency).
Account currency MUST match ledger currency; cross-currency accounts are forbidden.
Implementations MAY support additional non-system accounts, but posting templates MUST only rely on system_account_types.

close_period.purpose: Close a ledger period with monotonic period ordering and snapshot gating.
validation_rules: all postings.effective_at_utc >= period.opens_at_utc AND effective_at_utc < close_at_utc have published(org_id, posting_id)=true
open->closing sets period.closed_at_utc = close_at_utc; closing->closed requires drain complete

LOCKS-1 PHYSICS: Ledger mutation MUST acquire a transaction-scoped advisory lock using namespace 101 and a deterministic 64-bit key derived from (org_id, ledger_id). Implementations MUST use pg_advisory_xact_lock(key64) where key64 = (101<<56) | (hash_64(org_id||':'||ledger_id) & ((1<<56)-1)). Passing UUIDs directly to advisory locks is forbidden.

TEMPORAL ANCHOR: Producers MUST mint version via LedgerCursor in the same DB transaction as LedgerEntry+LedgerOutboxEvent writes: (1) pg_advisory_xact_lock(namespace 101 key64 for org_id+ledger_id), (2) SELECT current_version FROM ledger_cursor WHERE (org_id, ledger_id) FOR UPDATE, (3) v_next=current_version+1, (4) write ledger entries/posting, (5) insert LedgerOutboxEvent with version=v_next and ledger_id, (6) UPDATE ledger_cursor SET current_version=v_next, updated_at_utc=now().

create_snapshot.purpose: Create an immutable ledger snapshot for a period boundary.
validation_rules: Snapshot MUST reference a closed period.
Snapshot MUST be immutable and content-addressed (snapshot_hash).

Implementations MUST use pg_advisory_xact_lock(key64) where key64 = (101<<56) | (hash_64(org_id||':'||ledger_id) & ((1<<56)-1)). Passing UUIDs directly to advisory locks is forbidden.

post_entries.purpose: INTERNAL ONLY: post balanced entries directly. External domains MUST use post_intent except break-glass migrations.
validation_rules: post_entries MUST be treated as platform-internal only; external domain callers MUST use post_intent. Direct entry posting requires GOV-0 break-glass approval and MUST be auditable.
posting_id MUST be unique via UNIQUE (org_id, posting_id).
entries MUST be non-empty and MUST net to zero per currency.
All entries in a posting MUST share the same effective_at_utc.
LedgerPosting.effective_at_utc MUST equal entries[0].effective_at_utc.
idempotency_key reuse with different semantic payload MUST be rejected (ERR_CONFLICT).
Missing org_id context MUST return ERR_FORBIDDEN.
Cross-tenant access MUST return ERR_NOT_FOUND (hide existence per TEN-1).

When idempotency_key is provided, the ledger service MUST compute idempotency_payload_hash_sha256 as SHA-256 over the canonical JSON form of the semantic payload: {org_id, ledger_id, posting_kind, effective_at_utc, entries[], source_domain, source_kind, source_id, source_version, source_digest_sha256, tax_context_digest_sha256?}. The canonical JSON form MUST follow CANON-1 JSON canonicalization rules. trace_id and request_id MUST be excluded. If the same (org_id, ledger_id, idempotency_key) is replayed with a different idempotency_payload_hash_sha256, the request MUST fail with ERR_CONFLICT and subcode LED_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE.

Every posting MUST include posting_kind and source reference fields (source_domain, source_kind, source_id, source_version, source_digest_sha256). For source_domain that matches a contract in this suite (e.g., ORD-1, PAY-3, REFUND-1, TAX-1), source_digest_sha256 MUST be the authoritative digest from that source's immutable snapshot (e.g., order_price_snapshot_digest_sha256 for ORD-1). The ledger MUST NOT recompute price or tax amounts.

Implementations MUST use pg_advisory_xact_lock(key64) where key64 = (101<<56) | (hash_64(org_id||':'||ledger_id) & ((1<<56)-1)). Passing UUIDs directly to advisory locks is forbidden.

post_intent.purpose: Post a ledger change via a named posting template. LED expands intent into balanced entries and stores intent+posting atomically.
validation_rules: template_id MUST reference a template in posting_templates.library_allowlist.
posting_kind MUST equal the template's posting_kind.
LED MUST validate args schema for the given template_id; missing or extra required fields MUST fail closed (LED_TEMPLATE_ARGS_INVALID).
LED MUST expand the intent to a balanced set of entries using COA account_type mapping; external callers MUST NOT provide debits/credits.

idempotency_payload_hash_sha256 MUST be SHA-256 over CANON-1 canonical JSON of the intent payload: {template_id, posting_kind, args, refs, source_domain, source_kind, source_id, source_version, source_digest_sha256, tax_context_digest_sha256 (optional)}. trace_id and request_id MUST be excluded.

Replays with same (org_id, ledger_id, idempotency_key) and identical idempotency_payload_hash_sha256 MUST return the previously stored posting result; mismatched hash MUST fail with ERR_CONFLICT/LED_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE.
Postings MUST fail closed when the target period is closed unless the template_id is explicitly marked break_glass and actor has GOV-0 break-glass approval.

Implementations MUST use pg_advisory_xact_lock(key64) where key64 = (101<<56) | (hash_64(org_id||':'||ledger_id) & ((1<<56)-1)). Passing UUIDs directly to advisory locks is forbidden.

domain_invariants.text: Ledger posting outbox events MUST be schema-governed and final. Any event emitted under the ledger topic MUST be registered in EVT-1 with governance.source=derived_from_ash_resource and ash_resource_ref="LED-1:LedgerEntry" (or the canonical ledger entry resource). The emitted payload MUST be a strict projection of LedgerEntry public fields (no extra keys / shadow data). If a field is required by downstream consumers, it MUST appear in EVT-1.required_data_keys; otherwise it MUST NOT be emitted.

domain_invariants.rationale: Prevents cross-tenant money movement and metadata leakage.
domain_invariants.text: All ledger actions MUST require org_id in explicit context and MUST be tenant-scoped. Cross-tenant access MUST deny with hide-existence semantics (ERR_NOT_FOUND).

Any Ledger outbox event emitted by LED-1 MUST be schema-governed by EVT-1 and MUST represent a finalized LedgerEntry state (no partials). The event payload MUST be derivable from the LED-1 LedgerEntry public attributes (mirror semantics) and MUST NOT contain Shadow Data keys not declared as required_data_keys in EVT-1. If an event is marked final:true in EVT-1, LED-1 MUST treat the underlying LedgerEntry as immutable and MUST NOT emit compensating mutations via the same event_type (use a new event version instead).

domain_invariants.rationale: Prevents inconsistent money state and reconciliation divergence.
domain_invariants.text: Posting creation MUST be atomic and MUST validate balanced entries per currency before commit; no intermediate partial posting state is permitted.
No read-modify-write is permitted for balances, period state, or snapshot content. Mutations MUST use atomic database predicates per LOCKS-1.

domain_invariants.rationale: Network retries must not create duplicate postings or silent divergence.
domain_invariants.text: post_entries MUST be idempotent via (org_id, ledger_id, idempotency_key). A replay with an identical semantic payload MUST return the prior result; a replay with a changed semantic payload MUST return ERR_CONFLICT.

domain_invariants.rationale: Prevents phantom events and preserves traceability.
domain_invariants.text: Ledger outbox events MUST be written transactionally in the same commit as the posting/period/snapshot change. Event payloads MUST include org_id, trace_id, and request_id.

domain_invariants.rationale: Prevents cross-tenant posting via account_id injection.
domain_invariants.text: LedgerEntry.account_id MUST belong to the same (org_id, ledger_id) as the posting referenced by LedgerEntry.posting_id. Cross-ledger or cross-tenant account references are forbidden and MUST be validated before entry creation.

LedgerOutboxAck.event_id MUST reference LedgerOutboxEvent.event_id. LedgerOutboxAck.org_id MUST equal LedgerOutboxEvent.org_id and LedgerOutboxAck.posting_id MUST equal LedgerOutboxEvent.aggregate_id.

domain_invariants.statement: If a posting is created with an idempotency_key, the ledger MUST bind that key to the semantic payload by storing idempotency_payload_hash_sha256 and enforcing that any replay under the same (org_id, ledger_id, idempotency_key) MUST have an identical semantic payload hash.
domain_invariants.title: Idempotency semantic hash binding

domain_invariants.statement: Every ledger posting MUST carry posting_kind and a source reference (source_domain, source_kind, source_id, source_version, source_digest_sha256). These fields MUST be sufficient to reconcile the ledger to upstream authoritative records (orders, payments, refunds, tax adjustments) without ambiguity.
domain_invariants.title: Postings are source-referenced and auditable

domain_invariants.statement: Ledger postings that include tax MUST use tax values as provided by upstream authoritative records (TAX-1 OrderTaxRecord / TaxAdjustmentRecord and the ORD-1 price snapshot). The ledger MUST NOT recompute taxes from rates; it records source_digest_sha256 and, when present, tax_context_digest_sha256 for audit and remittance.
domain_invariants.title: Tax is recorded, not recomputed

domain_invariants.text: Outbox workers MUST implement a 500ms visibility window (T_gap=500ms) to prevent false-positive version gaps due to Postgres commit/visibility skew. If an event for (org_id, ledger_id) is observed with version > expected_next_version, the worker MUST buffer the higher-version event and wait up to T_gap for the missing expected_next_version to become visible. If the missing version becomes visible within T_gap, the worker MUST flush buffered events in strict ascending version order without opening the circuit. If expected_next_version is still missing after T_gap expires, the worker MUST OPEN CIRCUIT for that ledger_id stream, MUST halt publishing for that ledger_id, and MUST emit a governed anomaly/alert indicating a version gap requiring operator investigation/backfill.

The LED-1 producer MUST NOT hardcode registry_version_sha. It MUST resolve registry_version_sha at runtime from the V42_RUNTIME_REGISTRY_SHA environment configuration. If this configuration is missing or malformed (not 64-hex), the producer MUST fail to start or MUST refuse to emit outbox events. In Backfill Mode only, the producer MAY emit the LEGACY_SHA_SENTINEL (64 zeros) as defined in EVT-1 envelope governance; normal runtime emission MUST use the bound SHA.

Slide-to-open posting_date_strategy MUST be deterministic. If occurred_at_utc (or a refund's authoritative issuance_at_utc) lands in a CLOSED period, the service MUST select an OPEN period as follows: choose the OPEN period with the MIN(start_at_utc) such that start_at_utc >= occurred_at_utc. If no such OPEN period exists, the operation MUST fail closed with an ERR_LED_NO_OPEN_PERIOD. The selected posting_period_id MUST be recorded on the finalized LedgerPosting.

Refund clock + audit linkage are non-negotiable. For refund-related postings, LedgerPostingIntent.refs MUST include tax_credit_note_id (uuid_v7) when a TAX-1 CreditNote exists. The Ledger service MUST be barred from sampling its own clock: LedgerPostingIntent.occurred_at_utc MUST be bitwise identical to TAX-1 CreditNote.issuance_at_utc (authoritative clock), and LedgerPosting.occurred_at_utc MUST be bitwise identical to LedgerPostingIntent.occurred_at_utc. LedgerEntry.refs MUST carry tax_credit_note_id to enable one-click audit linkage from ledger to tax evidence.

Origin attribution MUST persist on the journal. For postings derived from historical liabilities (e.g., refunds of prior-period sales), origin_period_id and origin_tax_point_at_utc MUST be stored on the finalized LedgerPosting (not only on intents). Any finalized LedgerPosting created from a LedgerPostingIntent that supplied these fields MUST copy them verbatim.

double_entry_model.reversal_rule: Reversal postings MUST negate the original posting exactly and reference reverses_posting_id.

bounded_label_rules.rationale: org_id and ledger_id create cardinality explosions; use logs/traces for tenant filtering.

payout_window_model.lock_rule: effective_at_utc within closed period MUST be rejected (fail closed).
payout_window_model.note: This satisfies suite-wide led_payout_window_state gating; contracts MUST derive from LedgerPeriod.state.

fee_policy.note: Platform fees represent non-recoverable PSP costs and are non-refundable by default; full refunds are allowed only when organizer absorbs the fee loss. Bucket-specific refund templates are required; REFUND_*_PENDING applies when funds are still pending; REFUND_*_AVAILABLE applies after payout window close.

posting_templates.idempotency: Idempotency is defined on canonicalized intent payload hash (CANON-1) and idempotency_key.
posting_templates.strategy: Intent-based templates. External callers MUST use template_id + args; LED expands to balanced entries via COA mapping.

templates.must: On provider-confirmed capture, record gross funds into provider_clearing against unallocated_receipts.

Allocate unallocated_receipts into tax_payable, platform_fee_revenue, organizer_payable_pending using immutable ORD-1/PRICE-1/TAX-1 snapshots. Platform fee is recognized immediately and is non-refundable by default.
On dispute/chargeback opened, move the disputed amount from organizer_payable_available into dispute_reserve for the counterparty_org_id.
When payout window closes, move organizer_payable_pending -> organizer_payable_available for the counterparty_org_id.
On payout execution, reduce organizer_payable_available and reduce cash_or_bank.
Break-glass: manually move funds from organizer_payable_pending -> organizer_payable_available prior to the payout window close. Requires GOV-0 break-glass approval and finance evidence reference.
When tax point differs from quote and a delta arises, record a tax_adjustment posting that preserves auditability.
Record rounding adjustments deterministically when required by allocation strategy.
Resolve a dispute that was won: move dispute_reserve back to organizer_payable_available.
Resolve a dispute that was lost: move dispute_reserve to cash_or_bank; if bank_fee_minor provided, debit organizer_payable_pending for bank_fee_minor.
Resolve a dispute that was lost: move dispute_reserve to cash_or_bank; if bank_fee_minor provided, debit organizer_payable_available for bank_fee_minor.
Refund principal only (fee non-refundable). Funds are returned from organizer_payable_pending.
Refund principal only (fee non-refundable). Funds are returned from organizer_payable_available.
Refund full amount including fee; organizer absorbs fee loss. Funds are returned from organizer_payable_pending for principal+fee; tax_payable reduced accordingly.
Refund full amount including fee; organizer absorbs fee loss. Funds are returned from organizer_payable_available for principal+fee; tax_payable reduced accordingly.

entry_fk_account.constraint: FOREIGN KEY (org_id, ledger_id, account_id) REFERENCES ledger_accounts(org_id, ledger_id, account_id)

entry_fk_posting.constraint: FOREIGN KEY (org_id, ledger_id, posting_id) REFERENCES ledger_postings(org_id, ledger_id, posting_id)

reserve_model.payout_block_rule: Payout execution MUST be blocked if derived available balance would become negative after reserves.
reserve_model.principle: Exposure controls MUST be ledger-visible; no implicit reserves.

notes: Business event time (origin). Preserved for compliance linkage even when posting is rolled forward.

notes: strict: post in occurred_at_utc period; slide_to_open: if occurred_at_utc period is closed, roll forward to earliest open period while preserving occurred_at_utc.

attributes.name: occurred_at_utc

attributes.description: LedgerPeriod id that contains occurred_at_utc at evaluation time. Required when posting_date_strategy='slide_to_open' to preserve source-period linkage.

attributes.description: Explicit ledger aggregate identifier; MUST equal aggregate_id for backward compatibility.

attributes.description: Monotonically increasing integer version scoped to (org_id, ledger_id).
attributes.name: version

resources.purpose: Transactional outbox for ledger events; emitted only after commit.

rules.text: LedgerAccount MUST exist; LedgerEntry.account_id MUST reference an existing LedgerAccount in the same org_id and ledger_id.
LedgerEntry MUST include direction=debit|credit and amount_minor MUST be positive. Each LedgerPosting MUST balance: sum(debits)==sum(credits).
Implementations MUST NOT rely on synchronous mutable balance tables for correctness; balances MUST be derived projections (LedgerSnapshot) and may be updated asynchronously.
LedgerPeriod.state is the authoritative payout-window state; contracts requiring led_payout_window_state MUST derive from LED-1 LedgerPeriod.state.

Postings with occurred_at_utc within a closed LedgerPeriod MUST be rejected when posting_date_strategy='strict'. When posting_date_strategy='slide_to_open', the posting MUST roll forward to the earliest open period and preserve origin_period_id.

published(org_id, posting_id) := NOT EXISTS (LedgerOutboxEvent e WHERE e.org_id = org_id AND e.aggregate_id = posting_id AND NOT EXISTS (LedgerOutboxAck a WHERE a.org_id = org_id AND a.event_id = e.event_id AND a.posting_id = posting_id))
Disputes/chargebacks/payout holds MUST be represented via explicit reserve accounts and reserve movement postings.
Corrections MUST be append-only reversal postings referencing reverses_posting_id with exact negation of original entries.

rules.must: Platform is Supplier-of-Record by default. Tax payable is recorded to platform tax liability accounts. Organizer amounts are recorded as liabilities (organizer payable) owed to counterparty_org_id. LED postings MUST include counterparty_org_id when touching organizer payable or dispute reserve accounts.

External domain services (e.g., ORD-1, PAY-3, REFUND-1) SHALL NOT submit raw ledger legs. They MUST submit PostingIntents referencing a template_id in the allowlist. Direct post_entries is break-glass only.
Platform fee revenue is non-refundable by default. Refund postings SHALL default to REFUND_PRIN_ONLY. Full refunds SHALL only be allowed via REFUND_FULL_ABSORBED or an explicitly approved template.
Early payout release prior to payout_window close MUST use EARLY_RELEASE_MANUAL and MUST include finance_approval_ref and GOV-0 break-glass evidence.

When resolving a lost dispute with bank_fee_minor, the caller MUST choose DISPUTE_LOST_RESOLVE_PENDING_FEE if the fee is charged against pending funds, otherwise DISPUTE_LOST_RESOLVE_AVAILABLE_FEE. LED SHALL NOT infer the bucket.

break_glass.must: Templates marked break_glass=true (e.g., EARLY_RELEASE_MANUAL) MUST require GOV-0 break-glass approval. post_entries is also break-glass only.

canon_contract_ref.note: A later strict CANON pass MUST align this canonicalization precisely with CANON-1. Until then, this section is normative for idempotency hashing.

canonicalization.purpose: Eliminate drift/hallucinations by making payload hashing deterministic across implementations.
rules: Canonical JSON MUST be produced with object keys sorted lexicographically (Unicode codepoint order).
Arrays MUST preserve order exactly; callers MUST treat array order as semantically significant.
Numbers MUST be integers for all *_minor money fields; floating point is forbidden.
Strings MUST be UTF-8; no escaping differences permitted beyond JSON spec.
No insignificant whitespace (no pretty printing) in the canonical byte stream.
All optional fields that are absent MUST be omitted (do not include explicit nulls) unless the contract explicitly says null is meaningful.

semantic_hashing.idempotency_payload_hash_definition: SHA-256 over CANON-1 canonical JSON of PostingIntent payload: {template_id, posting_kind, args, refs, source_domain, source_kind, source_id, source_version, source_digest_sha256, tax_context_digest_sha256?}. request_id and trace_id MUST be excluded. The hash MUST cover INTENT, not expanded legs.
semantic_hashing.payload_scope: The semantic payload MUST include posting_kind, currency, effective_at_utc, source_domain/kind/id/version, and all entry lines (account_id, direction, amount_minor, line_ref if present).

summary:
Authoritative immutable ledger for the Ticketing platform. Defines chart-of-accounts, balanced double-entry postings, append-only reversal mechanics, period close & payout-window states, reserve/exposure modeling, and deterministic idempotency with semantic payload hashing.

Update: Interaction model is intent-based. External domains (ORD-1/PAY-3/REFUND-1) submit PostingIntents referencing a template_id; LED-1 expands to balanced entries using the COA, enforcing fee non-refundability by default and supporting break-glass early release.
title: LED-1 — Ledger Core (Immutable Double‑Entry + Chart of Accounts)
